نتناسب (form VI)
# نَتَنَاسَبُ (natanāsabu) /na.ta.naː.sa.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَنَاسَبَ (tanāsaba)
# نَتَنَاسَبَ (natanāsaba) /na.ta.naː.sa.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَنَاسَبَ (tanāsaba)
# نَتَنَاسَبْ (natanāsab) /na.ta.naː.sab/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَنَاسَبَ (tanāsaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
